definitions.explanation: The order in which people or things come or are arranged; one's turn in a sequence.

examples.japanese: {順番|じゅんばん}を{待|ま}ってください。
{順番|じゅんばん}に{並|なら}んでください。
{次|つぎ}はあなたの{順番|じゅんばん}です。

notes:
{順番|じゅんばん} refers to order or one's turn in a queue.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {順番|じゅんばん}を{待|ま}つ (to wait one's turn)
- {順番|じゅんばん}に (in order, in turn)
- {順番|じゅんばん}を{守|まも}る (to follow the order)
- {順番|じゅんばん}を{決|き}める (to decide the order)
- {順番|じゅんばん}が{来|く}る (one's turn comes)

COMPARISON:
- {順番|じゅんばん}: turn, order (practical queue/sequence)
- {順序|じゅんじょ}: order, sequence (more formal/abstract)
